notes.title: Dev Blog #7: Enter the Dungeon
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

As you’ve hopefully learned by now, the land of Rowen is a treacherous one. Whether you’re traversing the majestic plains or combing the sprawling beaches, foes await at every turn. But if you think you can take shelter in one of Rowen’s many underground lairs, you are gravely mistaken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/1ea746052df97bcf54540a57d4750c11afce2be0.png[/img]
Beneath the surface lies a vast network of caverns and strongholds that are randomly generated each new playthrough, with each one being more daunting than the last. These dungeons are not merely dark and damp. They are treasure troves filled with riches that any worthy adventurer would covet. [b]High-powered weapons, cash that glimmers in the dim light, and powerful armour[/b] await those brave enough to seek them out. However, be warned: great wealth often comes at a price.

As you delve deeper down these shadowy corridors, you will quickly discover that they are [b]crawling with vicious creatures and cultists[/b]. Danger is ever-present and will stop at nothing to prevent you from laying your hands on their precious loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/980ee6e7b9642e13eaaffcf1ccfd22f3ffe900cb.png[/img]
The most precious artifacts are protected by even more powerful beings, [b]formidable bosses that will test your mettle and resolve[/b], serving as proving grounds for any adventurer, a rite of passage that separates the truly brave from the cowardly. 

So, as you prepare to venture into the world of Second Sun, keep this information close to your heart. 

The path ahead is fraught with peril, but the rewards can be grand for those who dare to face the darkness. Equip yourself wisely, trust in your instincts, and remember: [b]in Rowen, fortune favors the bold, but only if they are prepared to fight for it. 
[/b]
Safe travels, Sunborn

The Second Sun Team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Dev Blog #6: Bestiary of the Dark Sun
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

During your journey in Rowen, you will come across [b]various merciless monsters that will attack you on sight[/b]. These vile creatures are influenced by the Dark Sun. As Sunborn, it’s your mission to defeat this scourge. If you wish to survive these dangerous encounters, it would be wise to understand exactly [b]what kind of creatures will be standing in your way…[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/26d69e90fcbe34fa2fefae63ce7226e360570c2a.png[/img]
The mindflare is a [b]dangerous creature[/b], easily recognisable by its floating body and bright green eye. If you end up being noticed by its [b]deadly gaze[/b], keep a safe distance from it and attack with all the power you’ve got.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/b951f9907d240a9f8c8cc1ca2fbcaffe8c2d687e.png[/img]
The Nightmare got its name for a reason. Its [b]agile legs and hair-raising eyes bring terror[/b] to those who see it. We recommend you immediately attack when you come across a nightmare, as its [b]speed[/b] allows it to get to you quickly and once it’s near you, there’s no turning back…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/e659d8844caa9133a4689f43aacc4890195f634b.png[/img]
While similar in appearance, the Banshee and the Nightmare are very different creatures. This monster [b]shoots a deadly spell at any enemy[/b] it encounters. Keep your eyes open for any sudden flashes of orange light, and be prepared to face the wail of the banshee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/f3829d512f4a0c2817f26c7c94a9544450decd2a.png[/img]
The anguished are pale and slender creatures who do not seem dangerous at first glance. Their immense strength and adaptability, however, allows them to use the Empire’s weapons against itself. Anguished are often seen [b]carrying barrels of explosives[/b] in the hopes of blowing up its prey the moment they have the chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/f8c49edcaa269521990722f7e9f12f26c2d4ed7c.png[/img]
A kin of the Mindflare, the Frostmind is another floating creature with a singular eye. They have the ability to [b]freeze their prey[/b], making them unable to move and an easy kill. [b]Immediately attack[/b] when you see this creature, as it does not give you even a second to react.

There are many more enemies that you’ll discover on your way through the treacherous lands of Rowen, but hopefully this introduction will prepare you for most battles that you will encounter. 

Take down these vile creatures of the Dark Sun and [b]avenge our fallen comrades, Sunborn.[/b]

The Second Sun Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Dev Blog #5: Second Sun's Classes
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

Stepping into the treacherous lands of Rowen means you’ll have to be prepared for a fight. 

To do so, you’ll have to [b]choose between three different classes: Sentinel, Marauder or Diviner[/b]. Each one of them affords different playstyles, while offering unique challenges! But which one should you choose? Let’s take a closer look at the three classes in Second Sun, so you’ll be fully prepared to throw yourself into battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/97809401342f0cc8e7ccfbf91b5989cb484861b2.png[/img]
[i][b]“Light as a feather, faster than the wind”[/b][/i]

The Sentinel is a [b]warrior trained to fight in both close- and long-range battles[/b]. With a [b]crossbow [/b]in hand and a [b]pistol [/b]in their pocket, they tread through the lands, prepared for any enemy to attack. Their quick thinking skills make them essential on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/127e06cd81a103ff8e1b05bc5e38d966fbb17f4f.png[/img]
[i][b]“Molded by battle, trained to destroy”[/b][/i]

The Marauder is a [b]versatile frontline soldier[/b], who has trained for many years to become the master gunslinger they are today. You start out with a [b]rifle [/b]and a [b]revolver[/b], ready to destroy anything that crosses your path. Their fearless nature makes their enemies shake in terror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/81fb702ecaaca584ae2e90c1533c11c9af3ceb4b.png[/img]
[i][b]“Obliterate all evil, one heretic at a time”[/b][/i]

The Diviner is a [b]mighty fighter who uses the divine light of the White Sun to charge into battle[/b]. While they can still use guns and other weapons, [b]they wield an assortment of powerful weapons[/b] that require the White Sun's blessings, as well as very powerful spells. To be able to channel the divine light and direct it to their enemies, the Diviner uses [b]an ember staff.[/b]

Whether you silently stalk your prey, charge into battle guns blazing, or channel the divine light – there’s a path for every warrior in Second Sun. Which one will you take when the Empire calls?

Choose wisely,

The Second Sun Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Dev Blog #4: A Land to Explore
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

The world of Second Sun is a world scarred by conflict. As you step into the war-torn lands of Rowen, [b]you’ll quickly understand that danger awaits at every corner. [/b]

But underneath all the bloodshed lie green fields and rolling dunes –[b] luscious landscapes that’ll make you want to explore every corner of the Empire you’ve sworn to protect.[/b] This is very much by design! 

The art & environments of Second Sun are directly [b]inspired by 20th Century impressionist war paintings[/b]. Here, the beauty of nature and the cruelty of war directly flow into each other, creating one cohesive vision of beauty & bloodshed. In this blog, we want to delve into the stunning surroundings we’ve created for Second Sun and give you a taste of what you can expect to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/ec6317f37e683b0c7172ec9425feab2c0a14f06b.png[/img]
Eden’s Rest is where your adventure in Rowen will begin[b]. It’s lush, green, forested area with towering cliffs and hanging valleys[/b]. Large viaducts with decommissioned trains stand tall over the groves, acting as a reminder of the former glory of the Empire. Eden’s Rest is also home to [b]West Point Camp, the base of operation of your imperial battalion.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/c97b3f096561254c2fc92daec2dd3a9811e33258.png[/img]
Southeast of Eden’s Rest, bordering the St. June River, lies the Crimson Plains. Named after the [b]reddish hue of the fauna[/b] that can be found here, these grasslands sprawl at the bottom of Rowen’s mountainous terrain. Strewn about the plains, you can find the abandoned ruins of Imperial buildings and majestic monuments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/71e81e820ca5af8b91104d0573c4626e974033af.png[/img]
As you approach the ocean, the luscious fauna of Rowen gives way [b]to scorched earth and dead trees[/b]. The Ashen Coast is the starkest reminder of the war the cultists have waged on the Empire. Grey & barren, with eerie statues looming from hilly peaks, [b]the only beauty that remains on the Ashen Coast is that of the seemingly endless horizon.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/2d9c93089e5308c9e92d91b450945efadb821e86.png[/img]
Venturing through Rowen, you can see the dusty sandstorms of the Valley of the Damned from miles away. The valley is an arid desert area. While little vegetation is able to thrive in the valley, its real beauty stems from [b]the ruins of ancient civilisations that can be found at every corner of the desert landscape.[/b]

This is only a snippet of what you can expect when you begin your journey as a Sunborn. There is much more to discover in Second Sun and we can’t wait to see you chart your very own path through the vast lands of Rowen. 

The Second Sun Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Dev Blog #3: Level Up Your Skills
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

At their core, RPGs like Second Sun are focused on choices for the player. With their myriad of weapons, load-outs, and quest lines, they invite different playstyles, allowing players to choose the one that works best for them. [b]Skills are another key factor in this modular system: while leveling up and growing more powerful, players can use the Skill Tree to adapt their character to their own strengths & preferences. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/8a1f7d2644247451770e52970218a78f44ee3a38.png[/img]

Like in any traditional RPG, you can strengthen your Sunborn by relentlessly murdering foes and completing the tasks set before you until you’ve [b]gathered enough XP to level up[/b]. With each new level, you’ll get skill points that you can spend on our Skill Tree. 

As with many skill trees when leveling up in Second Sun, you can [b]choose between [i]Active[/i] and [i]Passive [/i]skills. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/efdb2fd7c2e65e33e3f1062bf8e9c6d617b1620e.png[/img]
[u][b]Active Skills[/b][/u]

As implied by the name, active skills [b]shape your actions in combat[/b]. From stronger attacks to health regeneration, they can make or break your run, [b]turning a shocking defeat into a successful dungeon crawl.[/b] You can load your [b]Action Bar[/b] with up to 4 Skills and use your skill points to make each skill more powerful as you level up.

[u][b]Passive Skills[/b][/u]

Alongside the Active Skills, Second Sun includes [b]a variety of Passive Skills that’ll boost your survival chances and make you better at taking down enemies[/b]. You start the game with one Passive Skill slot, unlocking up to 3 as you progress. 

Whether you prefer to charge headfirst into battle or adopt a more tactical approach, Second Sun’s robust Skill Tree and diverse skill options ensure that your journey is uniquely yours. Embrace the challenge, level up, and let your Sunborn shine!

[b]My favourite Skill?[/b] Meteor Storm. [i]I love to see my enemies go KABOOM![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Dev Blog #2: Into The Arsenal
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

In the past, we have talked about the world of Second Sun, and the influences behind it. Today, we are going to talk about [b]arguably the most important thing in an FPS: WEAPONS! [i](and how they kill good)[/i].[/b]

[u][b]Bullets & Spells[/b][/u]

As many of our demo players know, Second Sun has a variety of weapons ranging from pistols and wands, to fireballs and grenades. Rowen is a fantasy world where [b]modern technology lives side-by-side with the magical and macabre[/b], and no aspect can portray this duality better than combat! With magic and bullets at your disposal, the forces of the Dark Sun stand no chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/062c840a9481b1f82b8206d289df15ffffd50bea.png[/img]

[u][b]Find Your Style[/b][/u]

Getting more into the nitty gritty, these weapons aren't just for show! Shotguns, although very powerful, have short range and wide pellet spread, so they are great for close-quarter combat, but less effective in long distance encounters, which might benefit a player who likes to get in close to their enemies. On the other hand, magic, be it ice or fire, is not as fast as a bullet, however, they carry more than enough power to overcome that flaw! So where a Diviner might try to stay away in combat, a Marauder might rush in. If you want to play a style combining both, [b]how you choose to use these weapons and approach combat is up to you! [/b]

[u][b]Keep Your Favourite Weapon Close[/b][/u]

With this in mind, at some point in the game, the player will have outgrown the weapon they love so much, and choose to instead utilize something more level-appropriate. But do not worry, for all weapons, big and small, [b]have different versions with different rarities[/b]! Really like that fire staff, but its level is way too low now? Fret not, for you may find another at a much higher level.

Besides finding higher level weapons, you [b]may also encounter ones with enchantment slots which can provide even more versatility[/b] in how you engage enemies and allow you to reach even greater heights of power. The possibilities are limitless!

So venture forth and tell stories of your favourite weapons from the demo on our Second Sun Discord!

Happy hunting,
The Second Sun Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Dev Blog #1: Second Sun's Biggest Influences
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

Now that players got a taste of our demo, we would like to talk about some of our inspirations that went into the development of Second Sun!

[u][b]Boomer Shooters & RPGs[/b][/u]

Inspiration for Second Sun came from many places! Movies, books and TV shows all contributed to inspiring Second Sun as it is today, but those weren't the main influences. We were [b]hugely influenced old-school shooters like [i]Quake[/i] & [i]Doom[/i] and ARPGs such as [i]Diablo[/i]! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/c8743b76c47976b7d7eb4e1c82520c8101f85bfe.png[/img]
[i]Image: Doom as it was always meant to be played.[/i]

When creating Second Sun, the idea was to take the fast pace and visceral combat of an old school shooter, and mix it with the fun factor of looting new items and building your character, and we believe we have successfully merged these ideas into a satisfying game in Second Sun.

[b][u]Art & Atmosphere [/u][/b]
On the other hand, a lot of Second Sun’s atmosphere and art style, as well as the design of the wider world, come from [b]impressionist paintings of the early 20th Century depicting war and conflict.[/b] These inspirations not only bled into the world of Second Sun’ art style, but its narrative as well, and their influence can be seen and felt throughout the game.

[u][b]What’s next?[/b][/u]
We can't wait for you all to experience the full game when it comes out, but in the meantime we’ll be posting more blogs about the history of the game!

If you really can’t wait to learn more, don't forget to check out our Discord server to chat with other Sunborn awaiting deployment!

Warm Regards,
The Second Sun Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Second Sun - Welcome to the Dev Blog!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear soldiers,[/h3]

It’s been a while since we last checked in with you.

We are thrilled to announce that, after months of hard work and dedication, our team is finally ready to start sharing exciting updates about Second Sun! We’re eager to tune you into our development journey using dev blogs.

[h4][u]What’s Coming Up?[/u][/h4]

Over the next few months, you can expect a series of updates that will give you a deeper look into the world we’re creating. Here’s a sneak peek of what’s to come:
[list]
[*] [b]Developer Insights[/b]: Learn about the creative process, challenges, and triumphs directly from our team.
[*] [b]Game Features[/b]: Detailed breakdowns of gameplay mechanics, unique features, and innovative systems.
[*] [b]Character Spotlights[/b]: Get to know the characters that inhabit our world – their stories, abilities, and personalities.
[*] [b]Community Engagement[/b]: The opportunity for you to engage with us through a Q&A session[/list]
[h4][u]Stay Connected[/u][/h4]

We want this to be a shared journey, and your feedback is invaluable to us. Make sure to follow our Steam page, join our community discussions, and keep an eye out for our posts. Your thoughts and suggestions will help shape the final stages of development.

Get ready for an adventure like no other. The countdown to our first dev-log starts now, and we promise it will be worth the wait! Stay tuned!

Warm regards,
The Second Sun

notes.title: Second Sun: A grand new adventure, coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/3d68e50d78a017bb0bddac1315f52b0a4d2c83c9.png[/img]

In the dim, foreboding shadow of the [b]Second Sun[/b], amidst the whispers of lost souls, the cultists are on the verge of victory. You stand as the last beacon of hope in a world about to be consumed by darkness. 

Unravel the story in this brand new [b]First-Person Shooter Role Playing Game[/b] (FPS RPG). Second Sun offers high-octane boomer shooter-like action where enemies explode in glorious mountains of [b]loot [/b]for you to use. A sprawling open world awaits you!  

Develop your Sunborn in line with your vision. Use a wide range of weapon types, level up skills, and find or craft the gear that matches your play-style. 

[b]Want a first taste? Check out the reveal trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=zUTASzu5x2g;full]https://youtu.be/zUTASzu5x2g[/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Key Features: [/b][/h3][list]
[*] Enjoy the fast-paced combat
[*] Battle your way through the randomly generated dungeons
[*] Fight, loot and upgrade your gear and abilities
[*] Explore a beautifully crafted open map
[*] Customise your character, choose your class and join the Empire![/list]
[h3][b]Stay up to date![/b][/h3]
Don't miss any Second Sun news by joining our community. We’re eager to share more about the game over the coming months. So keep up to date with all the news on our social media channels below, or by clicking the ‘Follow’ button on the Steam page!
